output.reason: A 52-year-old reporting hot flashes, night sweats and irregular periods requests a discussion of treatment options, which requires clinician assessment of history and suitability for hormonal or non-hormonal therapy but has no reported time-sensitive feature.
output.patientMessage: You can start this with a Counsel clinician in this thread — they can review your history and go through hormonal and non-hormonal options for hot flashes, night sweats and cycle changes. Meanwhile, layered clothing, a cool bedroom and limiting alcohol, caffeine and spicy foods may help. Contact a clinician promptly if you develop heavy or unexpected vaginal bleeding, chest pain, or bleeding after periods have stopped for 12 months.
differential: Alternative cause of vasomotor symptoms and cycle change, e.g. thyroid dysfunction
